name: [UPGRADES] Weapon RNG
desc:
UPDATE 9:
-GUI Revamp
-Trading (100k+ rolls required)
-Many new items
-Many new enemies
-Champion Paragon Device
-New Impossible rarity weapon

This update was developed by Crafti Studios

How to play:
-Roll for weapons by clicking the "Roll" button.
-Use your weapons to kill enemies located in certain areas (enter the portal).
-Use materials from enemies to craft items that boost certain stats.

Join the group "COOL Pro Games" for +1x Luck!

Feedback and bug reports in the group wall would be
appreciated.
